_doc_: Detector #11 Phase 0 — funding-cost bit-parity golden fixture (2026-05-14). Layout: 30 bars × 30min cadence = 15h coverage, starting at a UTC 8h boundary. Funding events at 3 bars (bar 0, bar 16 = +8h, bar 32 = +16h — last index in our 30-bar slice falls AFTER bar 29 so we generate enough for the slice). The expected_cases drive a direct test against compute_eff_pnl_with_funding and the in-test TS-reference walker (see funding_golden_fixture.rs).
_note_: ts_open_time at boundary; 1700006400000 = floor(1.7e12 / 8h) * 8h. 8h_boundary check: (1700006400000 / (8*3600000)) * (8*3600000) == 1700006400000 → confirmed clean boundary.

expected_cases.name: long_three_bucket_24h
expected_cases._walk_: Entry at bar0+30min (NOT on boundary; bucket gets pushed to next 8h boundary). Buckets visited: 16 (+8h), 32 (+16h), 48 (+24h=86400000ms from bar0). funding[48] not in overrides → 0.0. sum = -0.00020 + 0.00015 + 0.0 = -0.00005. Long: raw -= -0.00005 → raw = 0.04 + 0.00005 = 0.04005.

expected_cases.name: short_entry_at_boundary
expected_cases._walk_: Entry AT bar0 (== boundary). Buckets visited: 0 (entry boundary itself), 16 (+8h = exit boundary). sum = 0.00012 + (-0.00020) = -0.00008. Short: raw -= sign*sum = raw - (-1)(-0.00008) = raw - 0.00008. Short from 100→96 = +4% raw → 0.04 - 0.00008 = 0.03992.

expected_cases.name: long_no_boundary_crossed
expected_cases._walk_: Entry at bar0+30min, exit at bar0+2h. Next 8h boundary = bar0+8h = 28800000ms. 28800000 > 7200000 (exit) → 0 buckets visited. raw unchanged.
